d:
Chinese vloggers in Dhaka are accused of paying local shopkeepers around 500 Bangladeshi taka to display Indian products such as shampoos, soaps and hair oils during livestreams. The footage was allegedly presented to Chinese audiences as scenes from New Delhi. India's Ministry of External Affairs has criticised the alleged misrepresentation and urged authorities to take action.
